An '''aide''' served [[Associate Governor]] [[Mothra]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The aide was given the responsibility for keeping an eye on the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] while he was on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to ensure he broke no [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] laws.
